national_news.title: Government Prioritizes Cost-Effective, High-Quality Infrastructure: Nitin Gadkari
bullets: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari stated that the government's foremost priority is providing high-quality and cost-effective infrastructure without compromising standards.
Speaking at the 4th edition of the Tunnels and Bridges Conference 2026 in New Delhi, he announced that the Ministry is preparing tunnel tenders worth Rs 2 to 2.5 lakh crore.
The Ministry plans to review subcontracting provisions and link tender eligibility to performance assessments of contractors and consultants preparing Detailed Project Reports (DPRs).

national_news.title: RDI Fund Equipped with Stringent Safeguards to Protect Taxpayers and Private Capital: Dr Jitendra Singh
bullets: Science and Technology Minister Dr Jitendra Singh chaired the monthly joint meeting of Science Secretaries in New Delhi.
The Research, Development, and Innovation (RDI) Fund includes a Conflict of Interest policy with stringent safeguards to protect both taxpayers' money and private capital.
Private equity sources are expected to contribute 50 percent of the investment under the RDI Fund model.

national_news.title: Youth Drive Formal Employment Growth with 79% of New UANs Belonging to 18-30 Age Group
bullets: According to the 'Pulse FY2026' report, 79 percent of new Universal Account Numbers (UANs) generated during 2025-26 belonged to individuals aged 18 to 30 years.
The 21-25 age group accounted for over 35 percent of new UANs, emerging as the largest segment entering formal employment.
Women accounted for nearly 28 percent of new UANs generated, and tier-II and tier-III cities accounted for nearly 69 percent of the deployed workforce.

national_news.title: Delhi Flags Off 200 New Electric Buses, Expanding Fleet Past 5,000
bullets: Delhi Lieutenant Governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu and Chief Minister Rekha Gupta flagged off 200 zero-emission electric buses from the Delhi University Sports Complex.
The expansion takes Delhi's total electric bus fleet beyond 5,000, while the overall bus fleet has reached approximately 6,800.
The government plans to convert the entire DTC fleet to electric and expand the total fleet to around 14,000 by 2028-29.
New initiatives include the Delhi-Karnal interstate e-bus service and 56 dedicated Ladies Special e-bus services integrated with panic buttons and Delhi Police 112.

national_news.title: Civil Aviation Minister Flags Off Expanded Transshipment Cargo Operations at Delhi Airport
bullets: Union Minister for Civil Aviation Ram Mohan Naidu flagged off the scaled-up phase of India's transshipment cargo reform at Delhi International Airport Limited's Transshipment Excellence Centre on August 19, 2026.

The reform removes mandatory re-screening of transshipment cargo, successfully reducing average end-to-end transit time from 60 hours to 20 hours based on the Chennai-Delhi-Frankfurt Proof of Concept.

The expanded network connects four additional domestic origins (Bengaluru, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Hyderabad) and two international destinations (London, Copenhagen), projected to increase monthly cargo carriage by nearly 80 percent to 3,183 MT.

national_news.title: Cabinet Approves Four Railway Multi-Tracking Projects Worth Rs 9,450 Crore
bullets: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved four multi-tracking railway projects spanning West Bengal, Odisha, Tamil Nadu, and Andhra Pradesh, covering an increased network of about 410 km.
The total estimated cost is approximately Rs. 9,450 crore, targeted for completion by 2030-31 under the PM-Gati Shakti National Master Plan.
The capacity augmentation is projected to generate an additional freight traffic of 76 MTPA (Million Tonnes Per Annum) while reducing oil imports and CO2 emissions.

national_news.title: India and Malaysia Pledge Deeper Cooperation on Public Administration and Governance
bullets: India and Malaysia held their 2nd Joint Working Group Meeting, reviewing bilateral cooperation in public administration, capacity building, and governance reforms.
Discussions highlighted India's CPGRAMS platform and the AI-enabled voice chatbot 'Samadhan Didi' for grievance redressal, alongside Malaysia's digital government initiatives.
Both nations adopted the Action Plan for the Malaysia-India Governance Partnership (2027-2029) to cement institutional engagement.

national_news.title: TDB Backs Orthograft to Commercialize Advanced Biological Dressings for Wound Care
bullets: The Technology Development Board (TDB) under the Department of Science and Technology (DST) provided financial assistance to Gujarat-based startup Orthograft.
The funding supports the project 'Production Setup of Advanced Tissue Derived Biological Dressings' for treating chronic wounds, diabetic foot ulcers, and burns.
The startup operates out of the Gujarat government's Savli Technology Business Incubator in Vadodara and holds two approved US patents.

national_news.title: India's Medical Tourism Industry Valued at $8.7 Billion in 2025, Projected to Reach $16.2 Billion by 2030
bullets: India's medical value travel (MVT) market stood at $8.7 billion in 2025, drawing over 5 lakh foreign patients, and is projected to scale up to $16.2 billion by 2030.
Bangladesh, Iraq, Uzbekistan, Somalia, and Oman emerged as the top source countries for medical tourists visiting India for treatments and AYUSH wellness therapies.
According to the Medical Tourism Index, India ranks 10th globally among medical tourism destinations and 5th in the Asia-Pacific wellness tourism market.

national_news.title: PIB Dehradun Organises Regional Media Workshop 'Vartalaap' in Chamoli
bullets: The Press Information Bureau (PIB), Dehradun, organized the 'Vartalaap' regional media workshop in Gopeshwar, Chamoli, on August 20, 2026.
Aimed at print, electronic, and digital media to disseminate accurate information regarding Central welfare schemes, women/youth empowerment, and GI tags.
Highlighted major initiatives including Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana, Ayushman Bharat, and Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyan.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman Addresses PSB Confluence 2026
bullets: The two-day PSB Confluence 2026 was organized by the Department of Financial Services (DFS), Ministry of Finance.
Announced a focused month-long campaign starting October 2, 2026, for youth above 16 years to engage them with the formal financial system via the Indian Banks' Association (IBA).
Emphasized maintaining focus on Priority Sector Lending (PSL) and enhancing financing across agriculture and horticulture value chains.

national_news.title: India’s Trade Agreements in Action and Export Performance
bullets: Combined merchandise and services exports reached a record US$ 863.1 billion in FY 2025-26, with merchandise exports at US$ 441.8 billion.
During April-June 2026, combined exports touched US$ 232.73 billion, registering an 11.37% growth.
The India-UAE CEPA (effective May 1, 2022) remains India's largest individual FTA export market, with bilateral trade crossing US$ 100 billion in FY 2024-25.

national_news.title: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports Announces National Sports Awards 2025
bullets: The National Sports Awards 2025 selection committee was chaired by former Supreme Court Judge Justice (Retd.) Arun Kumar Mishra.
Prominent sportspersons awarded the Arjuna Award include Tejaswin Shankar (Athletics), Treesa Jolly (Badminton), Vidit Santosh Gujarathi and Divya Jitendra Deshmukh (Chess).
Army Paralympic Node, Pune, was selected for the Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar 2025 for sports promotion.

national_news.title: Government Priority on Cost-Effective and High-Quality Infrastructure: Nitin Gadkari
bullets: Road Transport and Highways Minister Nitin Gadkari addressed the fourth edition of the Tunnels and Bridges Conference 2026 in New Delhi.
The Ministry is preparing tunnel tenders worth Rs 2 to 2.5 lakh crore, focusing on advanced technologies like precast methodology and Tunnel Boring Machines.
The Ministry plans to review subcontracting provisions and link consultant tender eligibility to performance assessments of Detailed Project Reports (DPRs).

national_news.title: RDI Fund Features Stringent Safeguards to Protect Taxpayers' Money and Private Capital
bullets: Science and Technology Minister Dr Jitendra Singh chaired the monthly joint meeting of Science Secretaries in New Delhi.
The Research, Development, and Innovation (RDI) Fund involves a shared responsibility with 50 per cent of investment expected from private equity sources.
Inter-ministerial consultations are underway to make the RDI Fund framework more inclusive for strategic technology requirements.

national_news.title: Delhi Flags Off 200 Zero-Emission Electric Buses to Expand Green Fleet
bullets: Delhi Lieutenant Governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu and Chief Minister Rekha Gupta flagged off 200 new zero-emission electric buses from the Delhi University Sports Complex.
The addition pushes Delhi's electric bus fleet beyond 5,000, with a total bus fleet of around 6,800, under plans to reach 14,000 buses by 2028-29.
A new Delhi-Karnal interstate e-bus service and 56 dedicated Ladies Special e-bus services integrated with the Delhi Police 112 emergency system were also launched.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Cabinet Clears Two Sugar Mill Projects Worth Rs 422.5 Crore in East Champaran
bullets: The Bihar cabinet approved two sugar mill projects with a combined investment of Rs 422.5 crore in the East Champaran district.
Kolkata-based Shree Ganesh Sugar Mills Private Limited received approval for a Rs 180 crore project in Chorma (Pakridayal block) featuring a 5,000 TCD sugar mill and distillery.
Rajshree Sugars received approval for a Rs 242.5 crore project at Kanjahiya Tola (Kotwa block) featuring a 5,000 TCD sugar mill, a 28 MW co-generation plant, and a 60 KLPD distillery.
These projects aim to boost the rural economy, provide a direct local market for sugarcane farmers in Bihar and Nepal's Terai region, and create thousands of local jobs.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Agri-PV Summit 2026 Focuses on Combining Farming with Solar Energy
bullets: The Bihar Agri-PV Summit 2026 was held in Patna to promote the integration of agriculture and solar energy.
Experts highlighted that agri-photovoltaic (PV) models can help maximize land use in the agrarian state and increase farmers' income.
Closer coordination between agriculture and energy sectors aims to support Bihar's clean and renewable energy targets.

bihar_news.title: Ministry of Railways Sanctions Sherghati-Kajree Broad Gauge Line Project
bullets: The Ministry of Railways sanctioned the Sherghati-Kajree New Broad Gauge Line Project spanning Bihar and Jharkhand.
The total estimated cost of the project is Rs 26.27 billion under the East Central Railway (ECR) zone.
The project involves the development of a 107.89 km long new broad gauge railway line.

bihar_news.title: Legal Status of Passports and Electoral Verification in India
bullets: The Ministry of External Affairs clarified that an Indian passport is primarily a travel document issued under the Passports Act, 1967, and is not conclusive proof of citizenship.

The Supreme Court, in Association for Democratic Reforms v. Election Commission of India (May 2026), upheld the EC's authority to conduct the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) in Bihar under Article 324 and Section 21(3) of the Representation of the People Act, 1950.

The court reiterated that determining citizenship remains the exclusive domain of the Citizenship Act, 1955, and designated authorities, while Aadhaar serves as an identity document for electoral verification under Section 23(4).

bihar_news.title: India's Electoral Framework and Verification System
bullets: US President Donald Trump praised India's voter identification system, citing its robust multi-layered security and checks.
The Election Commission of India operates as an independent constitutional authority conducting elections to Parliament, State Legislatures, and offices of the President and Vice President.

Electoral robustness is maintained through mechanisms like Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs), Voter Verifiable Paper Audit Trail (VVPAT), Booth Level Officers (BLOs), and rigorous scrutiny by political parties and candidate representatives.

bihar_news.title: Bihar's Critical Mineral Potential Offers New Investment Opportunities
bullets: Deputy Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary highlighted Bihar's critical mineral potential at an investment event.
The state aims to attract new investments and foster innovation in the mineral and mining sector.
Harnessing local mineral resources is projected to drive industrial growth and infrastructure development in Bihar.

bihar_news.title: Patna Metro Receives INR 628.32 Crore Funding Under Centre's Capital Investment Scheme
bullets: Patna Metro project has been allocated INR 628.32 crore under the Central government's capital investment scheme.
The additional financial backing aims to accelerate construction work across ongoing metro corridors in Patna.
The funding highlights the Centre's support for modern urban mass rapid transit infrastructure in Bihar.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Allocate Over 30 Coal Blocks to Boost Mining Sector
bullets: The Government of Bihar plans to allocate more than 30 coal blocks to boost commercial mining activities.
The allocation process is targeted for completion to accelerate local resource extraction.
The initiative aligns with meeting the state's growing infrastructure demands through local stone and mineral utilization.

bihar_news.title: Bihar initiates site survey for 129 EV charging stations across 23 districts
bullets: Site surveys have begun for establishing 129 Electric Vehicle (EV) charging stations across 23 districts in Bihar.
The initiative is led by officials like Raj Kumar to develop a robust EV charging network.
The project aims to promote electric mobility and build necessary infrastructure across the state.

bihar_news.title: Bihar inaugurates auction of mineral blocks, aims to utilize wealth for public welfare
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary inaugurated the auction of strategic mineral blocks organized alongside the Ministry of Coal and Mines.
The state government announced that over 30 of the 44 surveyed coal blocks will be allocated before September 30, with mining operations starting October 15.
Mineral-rich districts identified for optimal resource utilization include Rohtas, Aurangabad, Jehanabad, Jamui, Gaya, Banka, and Bhagalpur.

bihar_news.title: Key infrastructure and welfare highlights from Bihar Government Press Releases
bullets: The Kosi-Mechi inter-state river link project aims to expand irrigation and water management in the Seemanchal region.
Approval was granted for the Muzaffarpur-Sitamarhi-Sonbarsa four-lane highway upgrade.
Infrastructure including road and water supply for the Gaya Integrated Manufacturing Cluster (IMC) is slated for completion before 2027.

bihar_news.title: Role and Administrative Structure of Bihar Cabinet Secretariat Department
bullets: The Cabinet Secretariat Department is a core department of the Bihar State Government responsible for organizing meetings of the Council of Ministers and ensuring inter-departmental coordination.
It formulates executive rules for the execution of government works at various levels and manages protocol-related work on behalf of the state government.
Key administrative leadership includes Chief Secretary Pratyaya Amrit, I.A.S., and Secretary Md. Sohail, I.A.S.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Initiatives on Infrastructure and Development
bullets: The Kosi-Mechi inter-state river link project aims to expand irrigation in the Seemanchal region, enhancing farmers' prosperity and water management.
Approval has been granted for the upgradation of the Muzaffarpur-Sitamarhi-Sonbarsa four-lane highway.

Infrastructure including road and water facilities for the Gaya Integrated Manufacturing Cluster (IMC) is targeted for completion before 2027, with water planned to be brought from the Sone to the Falgu river.

bihar_news.title: Cabinet Secretariat Department Functions and Key Contacts in Bihar
bullets: The Cabinet Secretariat Department is responsible for organizing Council of Ministers meetings, inter-departmental coordination, and formulating executive rules.
Shri Pratyaya Amrit serves as the Chief Secretary of Bihar according to the department's directory.
Key administrative functions include protocol execution and management of the Bihar State Archives Directorate.
